title: Crop fields (2025) - focus on NUS crops
description: Amazonian tubers classified as Neglected and Underutilized Crop Species (NUS crops) in each farmers field, accurately documenting the characteristics of these species in situ. This process generated a comprehensive dataset comprising seven different crops: cassava (Manihot esculenta), sweet potato (Ipomoea batatas), aerial potato (Dioscorea bulbifera L.), achipa or chuin (Pachyrhizus tuberosus), pituca (Colocasia spp., Xanthosoma spp.), dale-dale (Calathea allouia), and sacha papa (Dioscorea bulbifera). Overall, the study captured the main characteristics of 683 varieties/404 species recorded across 273 mapped plots from 221 farmer households. The dataset is organized into: A) Household information, B) Field information and land-use history, C) Species names, D) Variety names, and E) Community collection points of NUS crops

title: Crop fields (2023)  focus on 	Potatoes, Oca, Mashua and andean fruit trees
description: A total of 206 farmers in Cumbal, Colombia, were surveyed utilizing ArcGIS Survey 123. Each farmer's field was physically visited, and the 'Participatory Mapping of Farmers' Fields' tool was employed to delineate polygons for each 'shagra', accurately determining their respective areas. This process captured the characteristics of 557 mapped plots across 206 farmers' households. The resultant comprehensive dataset comprises five distinct databases: A) Preliminary Information, B) Shagra Information, C) Land Use Over the Years, and D) Variety Names. These datasets have been individualized and standardized using the common identifiers 'GlobalID Household' and 'GlobalID Shagra'.

title: Crop fields (2023)  focus on Banana, Pumpkins, Taro, Mustard
description: A total of 200 farmers in Vietnam, were surveyed utilizing ArcGIS Survey 123. Each farmer's field was physically visited, and the 'Participatory Mapping of Farmers' Fields' tool was employed to delineate polygons for each 'parcel', accurately determining their respective areas. This process captured the characteristics of 773 mapped plots across 200 farmers' households. The resultant comprehensive dataset comprises five distinct databases: A) Preliminary Information, B) Plot Information, C) Plot and Land Use, D) Crop Information, E) Variety Names. These datasets have been individualized and standardized using the common identifiers 'GlobalID Household' and 'GlobalID Plot'.
